title: 第2360章 无踪第2359章 战略级魂骨技
slug: 自完美世界开始第2369章唐昊
content_zh:
转眼间，时间来到了高级魂师大赛决赛的开端。
在之前的几天里，来自大陆各地的参赛队伍已经陆陆续续的抵达了武魂城，这让武魂城比一个月前更显热闹。
东海别院内。
楚风正在看各个参赛队伍以及各队人员的名单。
武魂殿学院战队：邪月、胡列娜、焱……
天斗皇家学院一队：玉天恒、独孤雁……
星罗皇家学院战队：戴维斯、朱竹云……
史莱克学院战队：唐三、戴沐白、奥斯卡……
‘果然没有中洲队的踪迹。’
楚风暗道一声。
他面前的名单上，除了各个队伍的参赛人员，还有武魂信息以及等级，几乎不可能是中洲队伪装的。
要么中洲队不关注这一次‘剧情’，要么他们也和楚风的想法一样，想等团战对手先暴露踪迹。
‘史莱克战队里没有小舞。’
楚风念头一闪，对于这点倒是不意外。
前两天他用武魂殿的渠道，调查过诺丁城初级魂师学院这几年的学生，里面并没有名为小舞或拥有‘柔骨兔武魂’的学生。
如果不是这个团战世界的剧情在轮回者介入前就变了，那就是十年前进入的中洲队美美的收下了小舞这个刚化形不久、实力孱弱的‘十万年大礼包’。
至于顶替了小舞出现在史莱克战队的人，是原蓝霸学院、现史莱克学院的泰隆，武魂为大力猩猩，是个斗罗大陆本地人。
‘史莱克一行人的魂力等级和原着一样，所以冰火两仪眼的仙草，没有被中洲队得到？还是到唐三手里了？’
‘不然解释不了史莱克为什么能打进决赛。’
楚风略感疑惑，如果他是中洲队的人，没道理会让唐三得到仙草，哪个轮回者会将团战的希望放在本土人身上，而不是掌握在自己的手里。

总不能因为忌惮十年后入场的东海队，怕泄露行踪，就不去动那堆仙草，那毕竟是能对实力起到一定提升的宝物。
‘搞不懂中洲队是怎么想的。’
楚风放下手里的名单，别院外传来的喧哗告诉他，第一场战斗已经开始了。
东海队众人没有去亲自观战的打算，这要是被中洲队发现身份，必然会陷入被动之中。
在这短短一个月里面，除了凝聚了天魔气核的楚风，自认为实力近乎于封号斗罗之外，凌绯几人还在发育阶段，遇上高等级魂师没有太多反抗之力。
因此，一切以安全为主。
时间在楚风熟悉魂技中逐渐流逝，在太阳下山后，代楚风观赛的叶灵鸢也来到了东海别院。
“有发现形迹可疑、且是在最近十年崛起的中年魂师吗？”
楚风看向叶灵鸢，就见对方摇了摇头：“近期涌入武魂城的魂师太多了，我今天在上面看了一天，也没发现符合你描述的魂师或团体。”
叶灵鸢说着顿了一下，继续道：“巡逻队那边也一样。”
考虑到进入团战世界后，轮回者的年龄不会被主神修改，且中洲队来到斗罗大陆十年，魂力体系在前期也没有延年益寿的效果……
所以楚风会提出‘中年魂师’这种描述，因为在他眼里，中洲队现在的平均年龄应该在三十岁以上。
content_en:
In the blink of an eye, time came to the beginning of the finals of the Senior Soul Master Competition.
In the past few days, participating teams from all over the mainland have arrived in Wuhun City one after another, making Wuhun City even more lively than a month ago.
Inside the Donghai Villa.
Chu Feng was looking at the lists of participating teams and team members.
Wuhundian Academy Team: Xieyue, Hu Liena, Yan...
Tiandou Royal Academy Team 1: Yu Tianheng, Dugu Yan...
Star Luo Royal Academy Team: Davis, Zhu Zhuyun...
Shrek Academy Team: Tang San, Dai Mubai, Oscar...
‘As expected, there is no trace of the Central Continent team. ’
Chu Feng secretly said.
On the list in front of him, in addition to the participants from each team, there was also martial arts information and levels. It was almost impossible for the Central Continent team to pretend to be one.
Either the Zhongzhou team didn't pay attention to the 'drama' this time, or they had the same idea as Chu Feng and wanted to wait for their opponents in the team battle to be exposed first.
‘There is no Xiao Wu in Team Shrek. ’
Chu Feng had a thought and was not surprised by this.
Two days ago, he used the channels of the Wuhun Palace to investigate the students of the Junior Soul Master Academy in Notting City in recent years. There was no student named Xiao Wu or a student with the "Soft Bone Rabbit Wuhun" among them.
If the plot of this team battle world hadn't changed before the reincarnations intervened, it would have been that the Central Continent team, which entered ten years ago, gracefully accepted Xiao Wu, the weak and recently transformed '100,000-year gift package'.
As for the person who replaced Xiao Wu in the Shrek team, it was Tai Long from the original Lanba Academy and now the Shrek Academy. His martial spirit was that of a powerful gorilla and he was a native of the Douluo Continent.
‘The soul power levels of Shrek and his party are the same as in the original work, so the celestial grass of the Ice and Fire Eyes was not obtained by the Central Continent team? Or is it in Tang San's hands? ’
‘Otherwise, we can’t explain why Shrek can reach the finals. ’
Chu Feng was a little confused. If he was from the Central Continent team, there was no reason for him to let Tang San get the fairy grass. Which reincarnation would place the hope of a team battle on the locals instead of taking it into his own hands.
You can't just be afraid of the Donghai team entering ten years later and not touching the pile of fairy grass for fear of leaking their whereabouts. After all, it is a treasure that can improve your strength to a certain extent.
‘I don’t understand what the Zhongzhou team is thinking. ’
Chu Feng put down the list in his hand, and the noise coming from outside the courtyard told him that the first battle had begun.
Everyone in the Donghai team has no intention of watching the battle in person. If their identity is discovered by the Zhongzhou team, they will inevitably fall into passivity.
In this short period of one month, except for Chu Feng who had condensed the core of Heavenly Demon Qi and believed that his strength was close to that of a titled Douluo, Ling Fei and the others were still in the development stage and did not have much power to resist when encountering high-level soul masters.
Therefore, it is all about safety.
Time gradually passed as Chu Feng became familiar with the soul skills. After the sun went down, Ye Lingyuan, who was watching the game on behalf of Chu Feng, also came to the Donghai Villa.
"Have you found any suspicious-looking middle-aged soul masters who have risen in the past ten years?"
Chu Feng looked at Ye Lingyuan and saw that the other party shook his head: "There have been too many soul masters pouring into Wuhun City recently. I have been looking online all day today, but I have not found any soul masters or groups that match your description."
Ye Lingyuan paused and continued: "It's the same with the patrol team."
Considering that after entering the team battle world, the age of the reincarnation will not be modified by the main god, and the Zhongzhou team has been in Douluo Continent for ten years, the soul power system has no effect of extending life in the early stage...
That's why Chu Feng would put forward the description of 'middle-aged soul master', because in his eyes, the current average age of the Zhongzhou team should be over thirty years old.
